title: Citizenship can't be determined without fair hearing: Supreme Court quashes ex-parte orders by Assam Foreigners Tribunals
description: The Supreme Court on Monday held that a person’s citizenship status cannot be determined without a fair, lawful and reasoned process [Sabitri Dey v. Union of India & Ors].
